meta.title: 반듯 선반
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (반듯 선반, a three-tier shelf you put together alone in ten minutes (fictional furniture)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 반듯 선반, a three-tier shelf you put together alone in ten minutes (fictional furniture)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: An instruction sheet: white paper, black line #1A1A1A at an even weight, two pale greys for the shaded faces of each box; nothing else, so the steps read at a glance.
rationale.type: Gothic A1 in heavy weights for step names, part letters and counts, and the line; the pictures carry most of it.
rationale.motion: Manual logic: parts drop in or slide along dotted arrows into exact places, step discs pop, screws turn in one after another under the screwdriver, OK and wrong-way panels appear, the faceless helper bobs, works and steps back with a heart.
rationale.sound: Corporate at 112 BPM in C major with a recorded xylophone (VCSL, CC0) for the motion, a light kit; a woodblock for every part that lands, clicks for the screws, a ding for each step and a confirm at the end.
rationale.visuals: All code: every part is a box in isometric projection drawn face by face (top, front, side in white and two greys) with black edges in painter's order, so hidden edges are covered; the shelf is assembled from offsets per part.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: an assembly manual has no words to say.
